sentences.japanese: 何事をするにも志が大切。
sentences.english: The will is as good as the deed.

sentences.japanese: このコーヒー店には芸術家を志すものが足しげく通う。
sentences.english: This coffee shop is frequented by aspiring artists.

sentences.japanese: でも、仲間たちは志はあっても、資金調達やマネジメントには無知でした。
sentences.english: However, although our companions were willing, they knew nothing about management or getting money.

sentences.japanese: この点に関しては、私が英語学習を志した２０数年前とは隔世の感があります。
sentences.english: On this point it is poles apart from when I set myself on learning English 20 years ago.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は女優になることを志した。
sentences.english: She aimed to become an actress.
